name: Cars (Remastered 2009) — Gary Numan · kit pieces
description: This song as MPL with the drums split into kit pieces. The song, section and phrase rows and the voice, bass, guitar, piano and other rows are the ones in the song's own MPL file (songscribe.py); each phrase's single drum row is replaced by a row per piece — Kick (C), Snare (D), Hat (F#, closed), Toms (F, B, D+), Cym (C#+ crash, or D#+ ride where it plays more than once a beat) and Perc (F#+, tambourine) — all on m10. Each piece is measured from its own Logic Pro 13 kit-piece stem (logic13/): hits found in that stem, placed on the song's sixteenth-note grid, and written as the phrase's most common 1, 2 or 4 bar loop. A piece with no hits in a phrase has no row there. Grades (A 90%+, B 80-90, C 70-80, D 60-70, F below) say how closely a row reproduces the hits found in its stem everywhere the phrase is played. "text" is the same rows as name=MPL; lines.
prompt: Add the MPL for each of the Logic 13 kit-piece tracks.
